Documentation

Welcome to Mightora Roadmaps. Create a plan across workstreams and quarters, track progress, connect prerequisites and share a presentation-ready snapshot. You can do all of this without an account.

Build & edit a plan →Start with an example, customise quarters and workstreams, and link activities. Save & return →Copy a bookmark link to a plan, find it in your library and make backups. Publish a roadmap →Create a polished, read-only version and copy its self-contained link. Import, export & recover →Move plans between browsers and understand Markdown, CSV and backups.

Start in three minutes

  1. Open the editor. Go to Roadmaps and choose an industry example, or create a new plan.
  2. Make it yours. Change the quarter labels, workstreams, activities, dates and dependencies.
  3. Keep or share it. Copy a plan link for this browser, export a backup, or select Publish to create a read-only link for your team.

How saving works: Your editable plans live in this browser. A plan bookmark only works while that browser retains its local data. Published links carry a snapshot and can be opened elsewhere, but they do not sync changes.

Common questions

Do I need an account?

No. The current community edition runs in the browser with local storage.

Can someone else edit my published plan?

Not the original. They can save an independent editable copy in their own browser.

Will a published plan update automatically?

No. Publish again after changing the plan, then send the new link.

Can I use this for confidential plans?

Keep confidential plans local. A published link includes the plan data in the URL and anyone holding it can read the snapshot.
